mon/2c443323-dc8c-4941-9608-04d6b3ec85ed.text: An $11m-backed AI start-up has promised indie rights holders licensing fees and a share of revenue for training on their recordings, and the one number an artist would want to see, the split, is the one nobody has published.
mon/2c443323-dc8c-4941-9608-04d6b3ec85ed.rests_on: the fee and split were not disclosed

mon/2c443323-dc8c-4941-9608-04d6b3ec85ed.text: How the deal works: artists do not sell to Sonilo directly, Symphonic signs for them, and the payment comes in two parts, a licensing fee and a share of revenue.
mon/2c443323-dc8c-4941-9608-04d6b3ec85ed.rests_on: signed with Symphonic so that "rights holders and artists receive licensing fees and a share of revenue"

mon/21e94357-9b59-4abe-96c6-daf1f98cd6d2.text: The price of ElevenLabs's deal, around $100 million, reached the public through a news report of what its CEO said, rather than through a filing.

mon/21e94357-9b59-4abe-96c6-daf1f98cd6d2.text: Every outlet carrying the figure hedges it: the $100 million is reported, not announced, which is worth knowing before anyone quotes it as fact.

mon/83f20f43-6b46-40a2-9a9b-1007cb10f9bb.text: Kling raised 19.8 billion yuan in October, and Kuaishou's accounts show the money came with an annual return and a conditional promise to buy the shares back.

mon/83f20f43-6b46-40a2-9a9b-1007cb10f9bb.text: How the money works: investors are owed an annual return that builds up on paper each quarter, so the business is carrying a cost even before any cash leaves.
mon/83f20f43-6b46-40a2-9a9b-1007cb10f9bb.rests_on: represent the non-cash interest expense accrued

mon/83f20f43-6b46-40a2-9a9b-1007cb10f9bb.text: The size of the bet in one line: 19.8 billion yuan, raised by Kling in one month.
mon/83f20f43-6b46-40a2-9a9b-1007cb10f9bb.rests_on: Kling raised 19.8 billion yuan in October

wed/41874364-fcd8-4fd1-b7e7-91aca6235019.text: The AI inside Cinema 4D and ZBrush is not Maxon's own: the generation is handed to outside companies, Tripo and Rodin.
wed/41874364-fcd8-4fd1-b7e7-91aca6235019.rests_on: We work with third-party AI providers, such as Tripo and Rodin.

wed/41874364-fcd8-4fd1-b7e7-91aca6235019.text: Maxon's pitch to 3D artists is that the AI tools arrive with an off switch, so whether a sculpt touches generation at all is the artist's setting.
wed/41874364-fcd8-4fd1-b7e7-91aca6235019.rests_on: AI generation comes to Cinema 4D and ZBrush, but artists have an 'off' switch.

wed/de83ed89-f29e-4e5f-ad82-c698ec72a010.text: Epic used AI to move more than 20,000 Fortnite Blueprints into its Verse language, which is how a studio clears its own backlog before dropping a tool.
wed/de83ed89-f29e-4e5f-ad82-c698ec72a010.rests_on: Epic converted more than 20,000 Fortnite Blueprints

wed/de83ed89-f29e-4e5f-ad82-c698ec72a010.text: The AI-assisted run produced a working prototype, and roughly 3 million lines of code, which is a lot of reading for whoever checks it.
wed/de83ed89-f29e-4e5f-ad82-c698ec72a010.rests_on: The AI-assisted run produced a working prototype with roughly 3 million lines of Verse.

wed/de83ed89-f29e-4e5f-ad82-c698ec72a010.text: Unreal Engine 6 ships without Blueprints, and the company that made that call first ran its own Blueprints through AI to get off them.

fri/456c4fc3-530b-4fc8-9e92-5b5ea662ad87.text: The claim was that the music was 100% AI; the evidence was sitting in the tracks themselves, which named Suno in their own metadata.
fri/456c4fc3-530b-4fc8-9e92-5b5ea662ad87.rests_on: pointing to tracks that reference the AI music tool Suno in their metadata

fri/456c4fc3-530b-4fc8-9e92-5b5ea662ad87.text: What the AI music row cost the game with its players, measured in one number.

fri/c1bd8406-c267-426e-b586-d76e1ef68e5c.text: Festival AI bans rest on a form the filmmaker fills in, and Robinson says some animators are clearly lying on theirs.
fri/c1bd8406-c267-426e-b586-d76e1ef68e5c.rests_on: What bothers me is the animators clearly lying on their forms

fri/c1bd8406-c267-426e-b586-d76e1ef68e5c.text: How strict the line is at Manchester: one AI-transformed frame or sound, not just a generated one, puts the whole film out.
fri/c1bd8406-c267-426e-b586-d76e1ef68e5c.rests_on: If any part of the final moving image has been generated or transformed by a generative audio, image or video model, it will be deemed ineligible

fri/acb58370-aaca-4040-9c13-83f227a628ec.text: For all the noise about AI songs flooding streaming, the platform says listeners are barely playing them and playing them less.
fri/acb58370-aaca-4040-9c13-83f227a628ec.rests_on: Streams from AI-generated songs remain very low and with a declining trend.

fri/acb58370-aaca-4040-9c13-83f227a628ec.text: The same platform says what is growing is high-quality, differentiated music, which is its own reading of where the plays go.
fri/acb58370-aaca-4040-9c13-83f227a628ec.rests_on: high-quality, differentiated content continues to gain traction

tue/nytphotoshop.text: The New York Times has told its photographers not to update Photoshop: version 28.0.0 and anything after it is off limits for work on assignment.

tue/fcpcaptions.text: Apple's software can now caption footage and search its transcripts in 23 more languages, so an editor can find a line by what was said rather than scrubbing for it.

thu/synthfirmware.text: Polyend has put the code that runs its Tracker grooveboxes on GitHub, so anyone can read the code their device runs on.
